Meet Nancy

My goal is to evoke emotion and offer a unique experience with every piece.

Nancy White is a self-taught mixed-media abstract artist based in Las Vegas. Art has been her lifelong passion, and over the past decade she has pushed her work into new techniques and materials.

Surfaces

Canvas, tile, wood, glass and resin

Techniques

Fluid acrylics, stains, water, torches, airflow and gravity

Commissions

Commissioned work delivered to several locations

Collected

Local art shows and private collections
